name: ساختن عادت خوب
description: A Persian user wants to build good habits and shares an intention to walk each morning. Verifies the habits_building fact answers in Persian (tiny starts, habit stacking, environment, identity) and the intention gets a supportive need reply.

turns.text: عادت خوب درست کردن از کجا شروع کنم؟
میخوام هر روز صبح پیاده روی کنم

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: "چطور عادت خوب بسازم" returns the habits_building fact. Turn 2: the where-to-start question returns it too. Turn 3: the morning-walk intention routes to the need rule with a gentle proposal.
expected.behavior: Persian habit-building questions route to knowledge; personal intentions stay conversational via the need rule.
